H01.description: close() does not clear the pending debounce timer, so a rerun can still fire after the optimizer is closed, and pending processing promises are only settled if such a run happens.
H01.reason: group: B's split kept — a debounced rerun firing after close() (H01) and waiters never settled by close() (H02) are two wrong behaviours of close(), one group each (DEC-0717 one wrong behaviour per group); category: a rerun after close is an ordering fault, the un-cleared timer is its mechanism (A); anchors, severity agreed

H02.description: close() never resolves depOptimizationProcessing or the enqueued processing promises; it relies on a later runOptimizer call seeing `closed`, so waiters can hang forever when no run follows the close.
H02.reason: group D2 (B's split, see H01: the hanging waiters are a separate wrong behaviour from the stray rerun); anchors: union of in-hunk sites (150 is the start of close() that B added); verdict, severity, category agreed

H03.description: Removes the promise resolution from the closed branch of runOptimizer because close() now does it.
H03.reason: follow-on of D2: the closed-branch promise resolution moves into close(); both annotators call it follow-on, the group follows the D1/D2 split

H04.description: Removes the duplicate enqueued-promise resolution after a cancelled run because close() now does it.
H04.reason: follow-on of D2: the redundant post-run resolution is removed because close() now settles the promises; both annotators call it follow-on, the group follows the D1/D2 split
